name: Aphelion of Jupiter
description:
[blue]Eclipses[/blue] the Runic Tome. When you would cast the Void, Gusts, Kinesis, or Sparks spells, you instead cast [term:greatredspot]Great Red Spot[/term].

[gray]At giant's reach, a crimson storm older than magic.[/gray]
